title: Bud Powell, George Treadwell and Sarah Vaughan at the Apollo
summary: Parker's friends in the band included Bud Powell and George Treadwell, who met Sarah Vaughan on Amateur Night at the Apollo.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Yeah, he did, didn't he. Were there any guys in the band that he'd buddied up with? Or was he a loner?
No, he liked Bud Powell. Bud Powell was -- that was Bud Powell's idol.
Yeah.
And they used to get along fine together.
Yeah.
And Treadwell. George Treadwell.
Yeah.
He got along with him. Those three
used to hang out together.
Did Treadwell marry Sarah Vaughan?
I think so, yeah.
Yeah. Well, so, was he a modernist, too, or starting to be?
Yeah. Uh-huh.
Yeah.
Well, how he met Sarah Vaughan, my band was playing at the Apollo Theater, and they had Amateur Night, and Sarah Vaughan came on the Amateur Night. And that's how he met Sarah Vaughan.
You heard her?
I was upstairs in the dressing room.
No kidding?
And he came running up there and said, 'Come on down here and listen to this girl.'
Did you go down?
No. I was drinking Scotch or something.
Yeah. Yeah. I can't remember -- well, Earl picked her up from there. I think Earl picked her up right from there. From that very time. And she was -- your band was playing the show.
My band was playing the show.
That's right. Yeah. That's right. Well,
